news.headline: DigiStor Appoints Michael Callahan to Board of Directors
news.summary: VANCOUVER, Wash., September 08, 2026--DigiStor, a leading provider of secure data-at-rest protection solutions, today announced the appointment of Michael Callahan to its board of directors. Callahan’s appointment strengthens DigiStor’s leadership as the company continues to expand its secure storage and data protection portfolio.
